day3_lunch_start.text: *Lunchtime. I opened my desk drawer, and there's a note inside.*

day3_lunch_note_yuna.text: *'Sunbae, please come to the rooftop during lunch. Make sure you come alone. It's important. - Yuna'*

day3_lunch_note_yuna_2.text: *A black thread, like it came loose from a camera strap, is stuck to the bottom of the note.*

day3_lunch_note_yuna_brief.text: *'Sunbae, please come to the rooftop at lunch. There's something important. - Yuna'*

day3_lunch_note_yuna_brief_2.text: *She's the photography club junior I briefly greeted on the field. The ends of the letters are pressed down in a hurry.*

day3_lunch_note_unknown.text: *'Sunbae, please come to the rooftop during lunch. Make sure you come alone. It's important. - Yuna'*

day3_lunch_note_unknown_2.text: *Yuna. An unfamiliar name. I try to picture the class seating chart, but that square is empty.*

day3_lunch_note_unknown_3.text:
*When I fold the note, a little dust falls from inside the paper.

*I put it in my pocket. The note with the unfamiliar name grows thin, pressed by my body heat.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_3.text: *Her hands are trembling. Yuna's hands. The knuckles gripping the camera are white.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_5.text: *I took the camera. A photo is on the screen.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_6.text: *A student standing in front of the school gate. Short black hair. Stiff uniform. Name tag: 'Kim Dojin.'*

day3_lunch_rooftop_8.text: *Same school gate. Different student. Brown hair. Name tag: 'Park Seojin.'*

day3_lunch_rooftop_10.text: *A boy with long hair. Haggard face. Name tag: 'Kim Taeho.'*

day3_lunch_rooftop_12.text: *...The last photo. In front of the school gate. Yesterday morning.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_15.text: *I couldn't put the camera down. I swiped back to the beginning. Slowly. One photo at a time.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_18.text: ***13 photos. 13 name tags. The same face.***

day3_lunch_rooftop_19.text: *Yuna says nothing. She's just watching me. Her eyes are red.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_20.text: *The hand holding the camera is trembling. -- My hand.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_21.text: *I look at Yuna. She's biting her lip. The fabric inside her camera strap is frayed, as if it's been rubbed for a long time.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_22.text: *I open my mouth, but the first word won't come out. Only the last photo on the camera screen stays lit.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_23.text: *Yuna finally opens her mouth. A small voice.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_24.text: ...They disappear every time. A week at most.

day3_lunch_rooftop_27.text: *I tugged at my tie. The air catches in my throat as I try to breathe in.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_28.text: *I tried to return the camera to Yuna -- but she shook her head.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_30.text: *Moisture gathers at the ends of Yuna's lashes. She doesn't wipe it away.*

day3_lunch_door_1.text: *...! Suddenly the rooftop door slammed shut with a BANG.*

day3_lunch_door_2.text: *I push the door. It won't open. It's been locked from the outside.*

choices: Bang on the door and shout

day3_lunch_door_bang.text: *I pounded on the door hard. 5 minutes later, the door opens. Nobody there. No lock either. ...No trace of who locked it.*

day3_lunch_door_wait.text: *I held Yuna's shoulders and calmed her down. 5 minutes later, the door opens. Nobody there. No lock either. ...No trace of who locked it.*

day3_lunch_door_open.text: *We go down the stairs. Yuna follows behind me. Neither of us says a word.*

day3_lunch_door_open_2.text: *The sound of the camera screen flipping still lingers in my fingertips. Click. Click. Click.*

day3_lunch_door_open_3.text: *The grout lines between the stair tiles connect in squares, like the name tags in the photos.*

day3_lunch_door_open_4.text: *"At my old school, I... with Minsu..." The next scene doesn't follow.*

day3_lunch_door_open_5.text: *The words came from my mouth, but my lips drifted over them like they were reading someone else's script.*

day3_lunch_door_open_6.text: *I braced myself against the wall. Saliva pooled in my mouth -- something rising. I swallowed it. Bent over, I pressed my forehead to the wall. The tiles are cold.*

day3_lunch_nametag_1.text: *...My gaze drops to the name tag on my chest. My name. Three syllables I've pinned on every morning.*

day3_lunch_nametag_2.text: *-- Suddenly it feels foreign, like a word from another language. I touched it with my fingers. Only the feel of plastic came back.*

day3_lunch_door_open_7.text: *Every time the camera in my pocket hits my thigh, I feel its weight.*

day3_lunch_door_open_8.text: *As I walk down the hallway, I watch the students brushing past me. Some start to greet me, then close their mouths. Some pass by like they've never seen my face before.*

day3_lunch_door_open_9.text: Sunbae, the photos... don't show them to anyone. Especially not the teachers.

day3_lunch_door_open_11.text: *Yuna splits off on the first floor. Before turning away, she looks at me once. Her hand around the camera pauses briefly in midair.*

day3_lunch_door_open_12.text: *I'm left alone. The hallway is long.*

day3_lunch_sea_1.text: You're eating with me today, right?

day3_lunch_sea_2.text: *Sea is smiling. The seat across from my tray is already empty, and there's an extra water cup set out.*

day3_lunch_sea_3.text: *I sat down across from Sea. Sea looks at my lunch tray.*

day3_lunch_sea_4.text: Today's menu looks good. {name}, you like mackerel, right.

day3_lunch_sea_5.text: *...I never said I like mackerel. I do like it, though.*

choices: Pass it off as a joke

day3_lunch_sea_7.text: I saw you yesterday when you were picking side dishes. You went for the fish first.

day3_lunch_sea_8.text: *The tips of Sea's chopsticks stop over a piece of mackerel. Even while she waits for my answer, her smile stays exactly the same.*

day3_lunch_sea_9.text: ...{name}, you seem to be wandering around alone a lot lately?

day3_lunch_sea_12.text: *Sea picks up a side dish with her chopsticks and stops. Her gaze is fixed on her tray. A long silence.*

day3_lunch_sea_13.text: *It's noisy all around. At this table, all I hear is chopsticks touching plates.*

day3_lunch_sea_14.text: ...You're hiding something from me, aren't you.

day3_lunch_sea_15.text: *Sea's voice drops. The hand gripping her chopsticks presses against the edge of the tray. The piece of mackerel splits in half.*

day3_lunch_sea_17.text: *Sea smiles. The corners of her mouth rise first, and a beat later, her eyes follow.*

day3_lunch_riin_1.text: *I opened the nurse's office door. The smell of disinfectant stings my nose. Nurse Riin is standing in front of the cabinet. She turns when the door opens.*

day3_lunch_riin_first.text: What's wrong, {name}? You don't look well.

day3_lunch_riin_first_2.text: *...This is my first time in the nurse's office, but she called my name right away. Did she see it in the attendance roster?*

day3_lunch_riin_2.text: What's wrong, {name}? You don't look well.

day3_lunch_riin_4.text: *Nurse Riin points to the bed. I sat down. She places her hand on my forehead. A cool hand.*

day3_lunch_riin_5.text: No fever... but your complexion is bad.

day3_lunch_riin_6.text: *Nurse Riin turns around and takes something from the cabinet. I can see her back. She lifts one bottle, sets it down, then picks up the bottle beside it.*

day3_lunch_riin_7.text: I have an electrolyte drink. If you're dizzy, take just a sip.

day3_lunch_riin_8.text: *When Nurse Riin turns back, there's a clear cup in her hand filled with pale purple liquid. Tiny ripples keep forming across its surface.*

day3_lunch_riin_9.text: It's mixed with vitamins and electrolytes. It may not taste great.

day3_lunch_riin_choice.text: *Nurse Riin is smiling. The cup is held out toward me, but her other hand rests close to the sink faucet.*

day3_lunch_riin_drink_1.text: *I took a sip. ...A bitter taste lingers under my tongue. My mouth feels slightly dry.*

day3_lunch_riin_drink_2.text: ...You don't have to finish it. The taste is a bit much, right?

day3_lunch_riin_drink_3.text: *Nurse Riin takes the cup away. The moment she turns -- she's biting her lip hard.*

day3_lunch_riin_refuse_2.text: *Nurse Riin takes the cup away. She pours the contents into the sink. The moment the purple liquid touches the water, it loses its color.*

day3_lunch_alone_1.text: *I stayed in the classroom and ate alone. Through the window, I can see the schoolyard. Kids are playing soccer.*

day3_lunch_alone_2.text: *The sounds from the field cut off at the window. Only the tip of my chopsticks scraping against the lunchbox compartment remains.*

day3_lunch_alone_3.text: *I look at the seat in the back. Seolhwa's seat. That line in the attendance book is empty again today. Only the date above the blackboard has changed for the third day.*

day3_lunch_alone_4.text: *There's something on Seolhwa's desk. Writing in pencil. Very faint. **'Get out of here'***

day3_lunch_alone_5.text: *The chopsticks slipped from my hand. They rolled off the lunchbox lid and clattered to the floor — the sound seemed to echo through the entire classroom.*

day3_lunch_alone_6.text: *I run my hand over the desk surface. It's been carved deeply. It wasn't written once. Multiple times. Traces of the same words written over and over.*

day3_lunch_alone_7.text: *...The handwriting matches the one from the locker. My handwriting.*

day3_lunch_alone_8.text: *I've lost my appetite. I closed my lunch box.*

day3_lunch_end.text: *I came back to the classroom. Even after I let go of the doorknob, the chill of metal stays in my palm.*
